name: Caustic Vapor
description: The door slams shut, and poison gas fills the room.
disable: DC 36 Occultism check (master) or DC 36 Religion check (master) to exorcise the spirits

offensiveAbilities.name: Breath Snatcher
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A living creature other than an ooze spends at least 3 rounds in the room

Effect The trap activates and fills the area with caustic nightmare vapor, exposing all creatures within.

offensiveAbilities.name: Caustic Nightmare Vapor
offensiveAbilities.description:
Oozes are immune to this poison

Saving Throw DC 38 Fortitude save

Onset 1 round

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 4d6 acid damage and Confused (1 round)

Stage 2 6d6 acid damage, confused, and Off-Guard (1 round)

Stage 3 8d6 acid damage, confused, off-guard, and Stupefied 2 (1 round)
